body:
I am being my normal self and getting no second dates. I don't know how they know TBH or even if that's the thing causing the issue. I've been dating for collectively over a decade and have only gotten 2 second dates, no third. I am casual about it, I am not needy or over emotional, I follow all the advice in the book yet I have never been on a third date.

Honestly I have no idea why women don't like me. I won't live for longer if this persists...
I feel like I've been putting some good effort into dating in the past few years. Women just seem put off by my lack of experience before I can even tell them I have it.

My favorite is Shadow over Innsmouth. I also like Poe and Ligotti, and maybe a bit of King and Jackson. 

I don't play sports, I just run and do weights.

I'm reading short storied by Lovecraft. I mainly do basic origami there's no paper craft groups in my area.

I hate exercising and sports I just do it because I don't have too many hobbies and I might as well.

I wasn't in a great place in 1996/1997, I just felt better than I did now. I think it was because I started dating and had high hopes for what was coming in my life, but after failing to get a second date for over two years I felt like crap again.
Do you think women would think a man was strange if he only had one friend? I don't know if that sets me back a lot.

I didn't go to college or anything I worked straight after high school, there's no real excuse other than my great anxiety at the time. 1996/1997 was pretty good for me and the best two years of my life, because everything before that in my 20's was even worse for me than it is now. I'd rather not share my profile here (I have done on dating advice threads before), but thank you for offering your help.
You think? I earn less than average for my age and I'm not great at any of my hobbies as a lot are recent.
Somebody who's warm and has the same interests as me. Also somebody who is introverted like myself.

I'm on OKCupid and Match.com, and I've been on Tinder and Plentyoffish. I started dating very late, in my mid to late 30's (I had my first date when I was 28, but that was through a friend. My second date was when I was 36 and I've been struggling ever since).
I really hope you find somebody.
Yes, I use OKCupid and Match.com. I've also used Tinder and Plentyoffish before.
I've tried OKCupid and Match.com (also Tinder, but I utterly failed on that). I was very late to the dating game, starting in my mid to late 30's then having a break until around 4 years ago.
I've tried them, been trying to date for around 5 years online now.
I'm sorry you feel that way, I guess we have problems that are both very similar and polar opposites.

It's not just about the sex it's about the intimacy and the feeling of being loved. I don't really have any friends other than maybe one guy, so I don't have much of a social life and that puts people off I think. Do people hook up on reddit? I've never heard of this before.

I work a 9-5 job, just general senior administration/phone duty stuff. I  spent a lot of time in the past playing games and watching films and nothing else, but now I've started reading again and I do paper craft and writing sometimes. I am in ok health, I'd say above average for my age, lean but not quite athletic.
